subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Delivery Consolidation
description: A quick, practical guide to Delivery Consolidation.

hook.text: You order 3 items from 3 sellers. Three separate vans visit your house on the same day. That's insane.

buildup.text: Delivery consolidation groups multiple orders for the same address or area into a single delivery trip.

discovery.text: It cuts trips, emissions, and cost. Customers can choose a delivery day to maximize consolidation.

twist.text: Consolidation adds delay. Customers who want everything now resist waiting for batched deliveries.

climax.text: Amazon's 'Amazon Day' lets customers pick one delivery day per week—consolidating orders automatically.

punchline.text: One trip, many packages. Better for you and the planet.

quiz.question: What does Amazon Day help customers do?
options: Consolidate orders into one delivery day per week
